# TraderCockpit

> Educational guides to backtesting and trading strategy validation: out-of-sample testing, Monte Carlo analysis, walk-forward analysis, drawdown and selection bias. TraderCockpit is also building a Windows desktop app for trading strategy research; the app is in development, not yet released, and checkout is closed. Nothing here is financial advice.

The guides are written by the TraderCockpit team. Examples use synthetic data and are not performance results.

## Start here

- [In-Sample vs Out-of-Sample Backtesting](https://trader-cockpit.com/learn/concepts/out-of-sample.html): what counts as unseen data and how a holdout becomes part of the selection
- [Monte Carlo Simulation for Trading Strategies](https://trader-cockpit.com/learn/concepts/monte-carlo.html): what reshuffling and resampling trades can test, and their limits
- [Trading Strategy Backtest Checklist](https://trader-cockpit.com/strategy-claim-audit-checklist.html): questions to ask about any published backtest result
